Class ItemUseState

java.lang.Object
com.viaversion.viafabricplus.bedrock.input.ItemUseState
public final class ItemUseState extends Object
A physical hold retains its air or placement route until release.

    • pace

      public void pace(boolean placementLine, boolean sneaking, float speedSquared, boolean creative)
      Native continueBuildBlock derives each repeat delay from sneaking, the build line and post-tick speed. Sneaking keeps 300 ms. A moving line waits 900 ms divided by its speed in blocks per second, at most 180 ms. Only Creative skips the 100 ms floor.
